goal: Runtime, WebGPU/CPU speed, contour quality, output similarity

baseline.note: HEAD already contained a prior session's 7 kept optimizations (typed-array FMM heap, sobel row-cache, monotonic quantile walk, inlined MS edges, join push/reverse, smoothing fast path). This session re-baselined on a heavier workload: 800x600, denser levels (interval=3), full pipeline incl. preprocessCPU blur + edge-guidance warp (default-on in worker).

best.output_similarity: snapshot within 5% tolerance (lengthRel 0.24%, pathCountRel 2.8%, coordSumRel 0.52%); byte-identical through iter 3; small accepted fp deltas from prefix-sum blur border normalization (iter 4) and inverse-mul level binning (iter 9)

kept_changes: applyEdgeWarp: far-field fast path (d^2 > 9*2sigma^2 -> copy-through) + inlined bilinear sampling (2.4x)
marchSquaresField: per-cell corner min/max precompute, per-level early-out, byte-identical (3.4x)
eikonal: stale-pop guard; heap values pushed as f32-rounded solution reads (fixes false-stale class)
joinSegments: packed-int candidates (idx*2+end), no per-endpoint objects (1.5x)
simplifyPath: iterative keep-mask RDP, explicit stack, no slice/concat/filter churn
eikonal: heap values Float64Array -> Float32Array (numerically exact)
eikonal: 4-neighbor loop unrolled to explicit blocks (identical math/order)
generateAdaptiveLevelsGrad: hoisted inverse-scale mul, |0 floor, branchless gNorm clamp
splineSmooth: faithful padded-index accessor (byte-exact; off-by-one caught by 2000-case differential test)
distanceTransformChamfer: INF-init folded into forward pass (identical output)
worker.js: ported f32 stale-guard fix (latent false-stale bug in duplicated solver)
verification: benchmarks/harness.js (best-of-5 full pipeline, determinism double-run, quality proxy: closed loops / total length / NaN check, 5% snapshot tolerance) + benchmarks/ab2.js (interleaved A/B vs git HEAD with per-stage medians + output identity)
notes: WebGPU path (js/gpu.js) requires a browser device; cannot run headless - CPU path optimized only, as planned. Machine under variable contention (~+/-8% noise floor); all keep decisions used interleaved A/B medians and required >10% stage-level wins or exactness arguments. worker.js change verified by node --check only (workers use importScripts, not runnable headless).
